buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Inspection Nominated Inspection Agency: On behalf of the Buyer organization, any one of the following Inspection Agency would be conducting inspection of stores before acceptance: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises (applicable only if pre-dispatch inspection clause has been selected in ATC): NIL Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: As per Inspection Clause or authorized representative of ED/OFBH on receipt of material 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Yantra India Limited Ordnance Factory, Bhusawal . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date

5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Yantra India Limited Ordnance Factory, Bhusawal A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Specification : Bracket Top for Box C-51A & Box C-52A as per Drg. No. OFB/C/1363, Det-11 & OFB/C/1364, Det-12 Ref. Drg.No. ISV-2031 DC No. 36629- A Dated 06/01/2000 Note- Supplier should submit material te st certificate form NABL/Govt. Lab Note : Sample should got approved before bulk supply along with Test Certificate from NABL or Govt. Lab. For conforming material to relevant specification given in Drawing. Pre Qualification Criteria 1. Firms should be established for any Steel Sheet or metallic Component in Central Govt/ State Govt/ P SU/ Public Listed Entities. Firm should submit Supply Order along with proof of successful supply (i.e. supp ly order copy, drawing, CRAC, Acceptance report etc). 2. Firm should comply the OFBH bid Item Specification, Drawing, Delivery Period (F.O.R. at Ordnance Fa ctory Bhusawal), ATC duly sign and seal. 3. Firm should submit proof of having requisite facilities to manufacture and inspection of the Bid Item. 4. Established firms at Ordnance Factory Bhusawal for bid item need not submit proof of past performan ce and facilities available at their end. 5. Non-compliance of above terms and conditions may result in termination of participation and offer of the Firm will be liable for rejection. Bids without submission of above supporting documents will be summa rily rejected and no further correspondence in this regard will be done. This may be strictly adhered to. IDDER UNDERTAKING I have read the clause mentioned in ATC in this bid and given compliance of the following clauses : 1) Specification 2) Drawing 3) Delivery Period 4) Option Clause 5) Inspection Clause 6) Bidder Financial Standing 7) Non-Involvement in Cartel Formation: We hereby give an undertaking that we will not be a part of cartel with other vendors and will be quoting competitive rates in the tenders invited by the YANTRA INDIA LIMIT ED, ORDNANCE FACTORY BHUSAWAL. 8) Material: Pre inspection report, Guarantee/warranty certificate and Test Certificate should be sent along with supply. The material will be checked by Govt. lab/NABL lab and the results of the lab will be the sole c riteria for acceptance of the item. 9) Loading/Unloading: Offer should be for Ordnance Factory Bhusawal. Unloading of Goods at OFBH premis es will be done by the supplier. 10) Product Delivery: a. Each package/bags shall be suitable marked with identification marking to enable satisfactory reference with the corresponding Invoice and GeM contract number. Marking on Each package/bags must contains r eference Invoice number. GeM contract number, Qty, Item description, Outer dimension, volume and gross weight in Units should as per contract. If identification marking on each package/bags is not available or n

ot matching with reference Invoice Qty then firm is responsible delay to acceptance of material or for any short supply. Every Gunny/Plastic/Packaging bag containing the material/component should be sufficient s trength/strong enabling to bear standard way of handling and not to tear easily. b. Supplier must generate Physical Invoice Qty as per Lot wise Qty of stagger delivery period mention in re spective contract. GeM invoice to be generated at time of delivery as per physical invoice Qty within delive ry period. If supplier get any difficulties to generate the GeM Invoice within delivery period then contact to GeM help desk to resolve the issue. c. Each Consignment should be Supply with following documents in 1. Physical Tax Invoice (2) GeM Invoice copy (Qty should be matched with Tax Invoice Qty) (3) Test Report (NABL or as per GeM Contract T&C) (4) Guarantee/Warranty (5) Pre-Inspection Report d. In case of Supplier has failed to provide the above mentioned documents along with each Consignment then material will not be taken inside the Factory. 11) Guarantee/Warranty: The stores supplied against the order shall be deemed to have been warranted b y the contractor against deterioration/defective material and workmanship and performance for a period of 12 months from the date of receipt of stores at our end and any material found rejected/defective during t he Guarantee/Warranty period, the same should be replaced free of cost. 12) Payment Terms: Payment terms shall be 100% payment through NEFT/RTGS only for accepted materia l within 30 days for the date of receipt of material or submission of bills/documents whichever is later. 13) For any other rules and regulations pertaining to this bid will be applicable as per latest YIL Store Procu rement manual available of YIL site : yantraindia.co.in/en/e-library Note: In case any query/information please contact to Provisioning section, Ordnance Factory Bhusawal at ofbhpvmm@ord.gov.in or 02582-222552, 222907, Extn-241. . 9.
